title: studio(packages): Delete uses two native confirms where the second's Cancel still deletes; Duplicate uses window.prompt; Discard changes asks nothing
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → package sheet → *Delete app* on a writable package.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Two consecutive `window.confirm` dialogs. The first: "…removes every object, view, dashboard and app in the package AND drops the database tables those objects created. This cannot be undone." The second: "Delete the DATA too? OK = also drop all records (destructive). Cancel = keep records, delete only the structure." — **Cancel does not cancel**, and it contradicts the first.
- *Duplicate* asks for the target id with `window.prompt`.
- *Discard changes (N)* discards every draft with no confirmation.
- After the delete, Studio lands on another package (showcase) instead of the Studio landing.
- `app-shell/src/views` holds 16 native `confirm` / `prompt` / `alert` calls; they are blocked or auto-answered in embedded frames.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`deleteApp` and `duplicateApp` in `PackagesPage.tsx`; strings `engine.packages.detail.deleteConfirm` and `engine.packages.detail.deleteKeepData`.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

One in-app AlertDialog: a radio for *structure only* / *structure and data*, type-the-name to confirm; a confirm on Discard; return to `/studio` after delete; replace the prompt with the inline duplicate form the landing already has.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *package delete native confirm cancel still deletes window prompt duplicate discard*: 4 hits (0 open, 4 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11001 (closed) — same native-confirm-instead-of-in-app-dialog family, record surface
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11695 (closed) — delete-confirm UX family
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: delete package native confirm cancel still deletes · deleteKeepData · window prompt duplicate · discard changes no confirm
